_comment: Edit this file to change what the launcher suggests. No rebuild, no release, nobody has to update anything: the launcher fetches it every time the MODS tab is opened. Keys are in English so anyone can edit it.
_about_featured: Mods shown at the top of the MODS tab. No badge and no number, on purpose: nothing here counts downloads, because the files are served by GitHub and nobody keeps a tally. A label saying 'most downloaded' would be an opinion dressed as a statistic. The information is that they are on this list at all. 'id' must match the mod's folder name.
